adjudication.rationale: In `packages/ui/form/MultiEmail.tsx` the component imports `Button`, `EmailField`, `Icon`, and `Tooltip` from the package barrel `"@calcom/ui"` even though it lives inside `packages/ui`. This is a diff-verifiable self-import and can introduce an undesirable circular dependency chain (`@calcom/ui` exports `MultiEmail` via `MultiEmailLazy`, which dynamically imports `./MultiEmail`). While it may not immediately break at runtime due to the dynamic import, it’s a concrete architecture/bundling concern created by this change. The note about the props type not being exported is true (the `MultiEmailProps` interface is not exported), but that’s not demonstrably a defect from the diff alone.
